summary: I reviewed the Kick-off minutes and HEP's draft APG and Performance Security forms, and replied to Thomas Becker confirming that QSE comments will follow by 7 December and setting out the issuing bank rating evidence we need. I also sent Khalid QSE's position on the APG, advance payment timing and payment certification to close REQ-001-client-p.

emails.subject: Re: APG and Performance Security - QSE review timing and issuing bank rating evidence
emails.body:
Dear Thomas,

Thank you for your email of 2 December 2026 following the Kick-off Meeting, and for updating the NTP precondition checklist to Rev B. I have reviewed HEP's letter HEL001-L-CM-HEP-QSE-0001 of 2 December and the draft forms of the Advance Payment Guarantee (APG) and the Performance Security submitted with it.

QSE will send its comments on both forms, or its approval of form, to you by Monday 7 December 2026 (ACT-002-KOM-01 refers). Our comments will focus on the demand conditions, the reduction and expiry mechanics, and the link between the APG reduction and recovery of the 10% advance of USD 9,500,000 under the Contract. Until the wording is agreed, QSE is not in a position to accept the instruments.

On the proposed issuing bank (ACT-002-KOM-02 refers), QSE cannot yet confirm acceptability. To complete our review, please provide the following:

1. Evidence of the bank's current long-term credit rating of at least A- (S&P or Fitch) or A3 (Moody's), or an equivalent rating from another recognised agency, dated within the last three months.
2. The bank's written confirmation that it will issue the APG and the Performance Security in the agreed wording, and that it accepts the demand-on-first-written-request mechanism in the forms.
3. The bank's list of authorised signatories and the method of authentication it will use for demands.

I note your point that the instruments cannot be requested from the bank until both the form approval and the bank acceptance are in place. I will confirm QSE's authorised signatories in writing before NTP on 15 December, and I will send them to you separately from the form comments.

For completeness, I also note that HEP's insurance evidence is needed ahead of my request REQ-001-client-c, which falls due on 12 December. I would be grateful if you could send it through document control as early as possible.

Please do not hesitate to call me if any of this needs to be discussed before 7 December.

Kind regards,

Omar Hassan
Client Commercial & Contracts Manager
Qizilqum Solar Energy JSC (QSE)

emails.subject: QSE position on APG, advance payment timing and payment certification procedure
emails.body:
Dear Khalid,

Further to your request REQ-001-client-p, please find below QSE's position for the items raised at the Kick-off Meeting. I would ask that Sophie is copied on this, in line with your reporting protocol, and I am happy to walk through it with you and Sophie before the form comments are issued.

1. Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security
HEP has submitted draft forms of both instruments (HEL001-L-CM-HEP-QSE-0001). QSE will return its comments by 7 December 2026 (ACT-002-KOM-01). We have not yet accepted the proposed issuing bank. We will need the bank's rating evidence, its written confirmation of the wording, and its signatory list before we can accept it. The APG covers the 10% advance of USD 9,500,000 and must stay in force until the advance has been fully recovered, per the reduction and expiry terms of the Contract.

2. Advance payment timing
The advance payment (M03) is programmed for 5 January 2027 in the baseline (activity A050). QSE's position is that the advance will be paid only after QSE has received a valid APG in the agreed form and an invoice for the advance from HEP. The Notice to Proceed is on 15 December 2026 (M01). Payment of the advance should not be made against an unapproved guarantee, and I would not recommend that QSE agrees a payment date earlier than the period in the Contract that follows receipt of those two items.

3. Payment certification procedure
QSE proposes the following for interim payments:
- HEP submits each monthly payment application with supporting documents, quoting the Contract sub-clause under which it is made.
- QSE reviews each application against the works certified, the 5% retention, the recovery of the advance and any agreed variations, and issues its response within the period stated in the payment clause of the Contract. We will confirm the exact period against the executed text before the first application is due.
- Any disagreement will be raised in writing with reasons, giving HEP the opportunity to respond within the notice period in the Contract.
- Variations and claims must follow the notice procedure in the Contract. QSE will not accept claims submitted without the required notice.

I will need the Owner's Engineer's view on the certification checks in item 3 before the first application, so I would ask Sophie to confirm that she is aligned with this procedure. For the record, this response closes REQ-001-client-p from my side.

Kind regards,

Omar Hassan
Client Commercial & Contracts Manager
Qizilqum Solar Energy JSC (QSE)
